description: Migration adds client_portal_visibility_groups.ticket_scope (text, NOT NULL, DEFAULT 'client') with a CHECK constraint restricting values to 'client' or 'contact'.
Migration follows house style: exports.config = { transaction: false }, hasColumn idempotency guard, and a mirrored down that drops the constraint and column.
Existing visibility group rows resolve to ticket_scope 'client' via the column DEFAULT, with no per-row backfill loop.

Citus distribution status of client_portal_visibility_groups is confirmed on a real Citus stack before landing; if the table is distributed, the migration falls back to the select-then-update-with-tenant-in-WHERE backfill idiom.
Index added on tickets (tenant, contact_name_id) via CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, with a decision recorded on whether to make it partial on contact_name_id IS NOT NULL.
ContactVisibilityContext gains ticketScope ('client' | 'contact') and isClientAdmin (boolean).
getClientContactVisibilityContext adds is_client_admin to its existing contacts .first() select, coalescing the optional field to false.
getClientContactVisibilityContext reads ticket_scope from the visibility group and returns it on the context.
A contact with no assigned visibility group resolves to ticketScope 'client'.
The resolver computes a single effectiveTicketScope that already applies the client-admin override, so no enforcement site re-derives it.
A contact with is_client_admin true resolves to effective scope 'client' even when their group is set to 'contact'.
The resolver continues to throw on a missing or cross-client visibility group, preserving the existing fail-closed contract.
applyTicketVisibilityFilter(query, visibility, { boardColumn, contactColumn }) is introduced, applying the board predicate as today and the contact predicate when effective scope is 'contact'.
The new helper takes its column names explicitly with NO defaults, so a caller cannot inherit an alias its own FROM clause does not define.
The chosen null-contact policy is implemented in exactly one place inside the shared predicate.
implementationNotes: Draft implements the recommended policy; OQ1 approval is still pending.

description: Board scope and contact scope both apply when a group is configured with both; neither predicate replaces the other.
All callers are migrated off applyVisibilityBoardFilter and the old export is retired, leaving no two competing helpers with overlapping responsibility.
The re-export shim client-portal-actions/visibilityResolver.ts is updated in step with the rename so it does not silently stop exporting a symbol that still has importers.
Enforcement: single-ticket gate resolveVisibleTicket (client-tickets.ts:158) applies the contact predicate, closing direct-ID access.
Enforcement: portal ticket list (client-tickets.ts:220).
Enforcement: portal ticket detail (client-tickets.ts:333).
Enforcement: ticket documents (client-tickets.ts:1082), using the unaliased 'tickets' column names.
Enforcement: dashboard open-ticket count (dashboard.ts:218).
Enforcement: dashboard activity feed (dashboard.ts:318), so no sibling ticket title or comment excerpt surfaces.
Enforcement: REST API applyClientTicketScope (TicketService.ts:284), covering list, search, count, and getById.
Pre-existing defect fixed: getClientTicketDocuments no longer passes the default 't.board_id' against an unaliased 'tickets' FROM clause.

ticketFormActions.ts:107 audited and explicitly confirmed to need no contact predicate (it lists boards, not tickets); the decision is recorded in a comment so the omission is not read as an oversight.
A contact-aware relationship template is added to RelationshipTemplateKey with both matches() and compileSql() facets, relying on the Record type's exhaustiveness to prevent JS/SQL drift.
The ticket authorization record maps contact_name_id and the ticket SQL adapter exposes a contact column, in both the ticketActions and optimizedTicketActions copies of toTicketAuthorizationRecord.

The duplicated authorization trees stay in lockstep: catalog and service changes applied to BOTH packages/authorization and server/src/lib/authorization, and the per-rule override block in relationshipTemplates.ts kept in sync with its twin in providers/bundleProvider.ts.
implementationNotes: Kernel server files are re-export shims; both catalogs updated. The combined template consumes trusted context and requires no rule-config/service changes.

description: ticketActions.ts:251 and optimizedTicketActions.ts:234 return the fuller visibility context rather than only visibleBoardIds, and both preserve their catch-and-deny fail-closed behavior.

getTicketById narrowing covers contact scope, closing the live-reachable GET /api/tickets/[id]/live-token path so a contact-scoped user cannot mint a Hocuspocus collaboration token for a sibling's ticket.
Hardening: the live-token route handler rejects non-internal user types directly, matching apiMiddleware.ts:235, so route access control does not rest on a downstream action's narrowing.
Portal-side zod payload schema accepts ticketScope with a 'client' default.
Portal-side create action persists ticket_scope.
Portal-side update action persists ticket_scope.
Portal-side list and detail read actions select ticket_scope, and the VisibilityGroup types carry it.
MSP-side action module (contactActions.tsx) carries ticket_scope through create, update, and read, keeping parity with the portal-side module.
prdRefs: Data / API / Integrations/Two action modules, two UIs

description: Portal-side group editor renders the scope choice using the existing RadioGroup component with per-option descriptions.
Portal-side editor hydrates scope when editing an existing group and resets it to 'client' on form reset.
Portal-side group list row shows the scope alongside the board and assignment counts.
MSP-side group editor renders the same scope choice, so a technician cannot edit a contact-scoped group through a form that hides its scope.
MSP-side group list row shows the scope, and the assignment help text is reworded so it no longer implies board-only semantics.
The contact-scope option's description states the client-admin carve-out and the chosen null-contact policy inline, so an admin is not surprised by their own unchanged view.
New client-portal i18n keys added to all ten locales in server/public/locales/<locale>/client-portal.json, including the xx and yy pseudo-locales.
MSP-side scope strings get real keys in server/public/locales/*/msp/contacts.json rather than extending the hardcoded-English precedent in ContactPortalTab.tsx.
visibilityGroupsLocales.test.ts parity list extended to include 'pt', closing a pre-existing gap.
algadeskPortalTicketing.contract.test.ts source-text assertion updated to assert the new choke point instead of the retired helper name.
User-facing doc client-ticket-visibility.md in nm-store describes the setting, the client-admin override, and the null-contact policy.
implementationNotes: Local guide and apply-checked website-docs.patch are ready; apply/publish in nm-store with the approved feature release.
